cohort: 341 women of reproductive age (96 nulliparous, 73 vaginal delivery with or without episiotomy, 172 cesarean section) recruited from public health centers in Ahvaz, Iran
finding: Nulliparous women had the highest pelvic floor muscle strength, while women who had vaginal delivery with episiotomy had the lowest.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in pelvic floor muscle strength between women with normal vaginal delivery and those with cesarean section.
